projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: Personal portfolio website built with Vue 3 and Tailwind CSS
projects.overview: A modern, responsive portfolio website built to showcase my work and skills. The site features a clean, minimalist design with smooth animations and a focus on user experience.
highlights: Implemented responsive design using Tailwind CSS
Built with Vue 3 Composition API and TypeScript
Integrated dynamic routing for project details
projects.technicalDetails: The website is built using Vue 3 with the Composition API for better code organization and TypeScript for type safety. The UI is styled using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/vue components for a consistent and modern look. The site is hosted on Vercel for optimal performance and reliability.
projects.challenges: One of the main challenges was implementing a responsive design that works well across all devices while maintaining a consistent look and feel. This was solved by using Tailwind CSS's responsive utilities and careful planning of the component structure. Another challenge was optimizing the performance of the site, which was addressed through lazy loading of images and components, and careful consideration of bundle size.
